name: Esashi (Hiyama, Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Esashi town emblem in white and red: two concentric outlined lozenges enclosing a red cogwheel-like device.
history: Municipal flag of Esashi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Esashi town emblem — two concentric outlined lozenges enclosing a red cogwheel-like device
